Does Adam Savage have advice for making the same thing twice? What are Adam's suggestions of practices to help someone develop their design philosophy? author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Unused concept sketches from the original productions of the Star Wars films have inspired the imagination of fans for decades, and modelmaker Landon Tilley shares with us his takes on a concept droid, creature, and Imperial Walker built with both old and new modelmaking techniques.
